title: Three.js port parity
description: Ongoing context log for Three.js port toward full Godot parity.

comments.author: talves
comments.text: Initialized Rapier physics in web port; added physics stepping in Engine; added static trimesh collisions for fortress/village/hills and ground collider; added FBX/OBJ loading for village/mountain with SkeletonUtils cloning; added arrow physics bodies w/ CCD + collision callbacks; wired animation mixers for player/remote/entity with basic state->clip mapping; copied village/mountain assets into public/assets.

comments.author: talves
comments.text: Added Godot Transform3D -> Three.js helper and instantiated all three hills with matching transforms from lands_of_balance.tscn; each hill now added to scene and registered for trimesh collision via Rapier.

comments.author: talves
comments.text: Inspected GLB animations: paladin has only 'mixamo.com', archer has only 'Take 001', bobba has no animations, dragon has multiple 'Dragon_Ancient_*' clips. Attempted npm run dev but Vite failed to bind ::1:3000 (EPERM). Added Rapier kinematic colliders for entities and arrow->entity damage reporting; updated dragon anim mapping to actual clip names; entity colliders now follow network positions.

comments.author: talves
comments.text: Investigated texture issue: GLBs have embedded images; FBX/OBJ assets likely lack external textures in public/assets. Added material fixups (sRGB, flipY) for GLTF/FBX/OBJ meshes and set FBXLoader resourcePath to /assets. Enabled THREE.ColorManagement in Engine.

comments.author: talves
comments.text: Converted assets/village_of_eights.fbx -> public/assets/village_of_eights.glb via Blender and switched web loader to use GLB. GLB now contains 1 embedded image; Blender reported missing image mappings in FBX (likely source texture refs missing).

comments.author: talves
comments.text: Re-exported Paladin FBX to GLB with embedded textures (paladin.glb now has 3 images, 1 animation). Added material fixups for skinned meshes (force skinning, map colorSpace + white base) to improve player texture visibility.

comments.author: talves
comments.text: Tried Playwright Firefox headless for console logs; fails with glxtest/X server issues and NS_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY even in lite mode. Added lite-mode asset loading switch (?lite=1) and added material fixups on player/entity clones to force sRGB + skinning; also re-exported paladin.glb earlier.

comments.author: talves
comments.text: Added model ground-alignment (Box3 minY offset) for player/remote/entities; added player texture debug log of textured mesh count. This should raise model origin vertically and help verify if texture maps are bound.

comments.author: talves
comments.text: Adjusted player spawn height by offsetting character controller to capsule bottom; added forced material settings (metalness 0, roughness 1, opacity 1) and optional debugTextures=1 to swap to MeshBasicMaterial for texture visibility testing.
